name: m01_sum_xor_to_or
description: sum: second XOR changed to OR, s[i] = (a^b) | c[i]

name: m02_no_generate
description: carry generate term a&b dropped

name: m03_no_propagate
description: carry propagate term c&(a^b) dropped

name: m04_carry_wrong_index
description: sum bit i uses carry c[i-1] (bit 0 uses c[0])

name: m05_cin_ignored
description: cin ignored: c[0] tied to 0

name: m06_bit0_sum_no_cin
description: bit-0 sum drops cin (carry still uses it); differs only when cin=1

name: m07_msb_no_carry_in
description: MSB-only fault: s[N-1] ignores its carry in

name: m08_loop_bound_short
description: loop bound off by one (i < N-1): s[N-1] undriven

name: m09_stuck_at0_bit5
description: s[5] stuck at 0 (no effect for N <= 5)

name: m10_stuck_at1_msb
description: s[N-1] stuck at 1

name: m11_b_bit_reversed
description: operand b bit-reversed (b[N-1-i])

name: m12_n22_only_bit20
description: only at N=22: bit-20 carry out = a&b | c (propagate qualifier lost)

name: m13_n12_only_msb
description: only at N=12: carry into bit 11 dropped from the sum

name: m14_n22_only_cin1
description: only at N=22 and cin=1: carry into bit 21 suppressed (breaks mac_unit subtract MSB)

name: m15_cin1_full_chain
description: only when cin=1 and the carry ripples through every bit (a^b == all ones): s[N-1] flipped

name: m16_rare_n22
description: only at N=22 for the single input a=KA[21:0], b=KB[21:0], cin=1: s[0] flipped (1 of 2^45 inputs)

name: m17_rare_all_n
description: every N: for the single input a=KA[N-1:0], b=KB[N-1:0], cin=0: s[0] flipped

name: m18_rare_n12_window
class: rare pattern, N=12 only, outside mac_unit L range
description: only at N=12 for a=12'hABC, b=12'h9F0 (b >= 256), cin=1: s[11] flipped

name: m19_latch
description: output through an always @* latch that holds when a==b==all ones (else transparent)

name: m20_default_n8
description: default parameter changed N=16 -> N=8 (function at given N unchanged)

name: m21_x_on_zero
description: s[0] = 1'bx when a==0, b==0, cin==0 (X output on a directed corner)

name: m22_comb_loop
description: functionally redundant combinational loop: c[0] = cin | (s[N-1] & ~s[N-1])

name: e01_carry_or
description: carry propagate qualifier a|b instead of a^b

name: e02_carry_majority
description: carry as majority(a, b, c)

name: e03_behavioural
description: behavioural s = a + b + cin (no ripple chain, no c[N])
